name: Georges
bio: A young Parisian whom Wilde called 'a great friend of mine' and referred to by the nickname 'le petit Georges'. In a letter to Reginald Turner postmarked 3 January 1899 Wilde wrote that Georges was then at Nice and that he had promised to go over and see him, describing him as 'like a very handsome Roman boy, dark, and bronze-like, with splendidly chiselled nose and mouth'. Wilde adds that he was visiting Nice 'on speculative business'. No surname, age or dates appear in the record.
bio_note: Two mentions: Wilde to Reginald Turner, [postmark 3 January 1899], Complete Letters (2000), p. 1117 ('le petit Georges' at Nice, 'on speculative business'); and printed 1108, the Kalisaya bar, December 1898 ('One beautiful boy of bad character… so like Antinous'). The editors' index treats the three mentions (1097, 1108, 1117) as one person. No dates recorded.
